title: The Porch Chord
description: A self-taught guitarist plays her first public open mic after overcoming crippling stage fright.
character_reference: a teenage girl with tousled auburn hair in a messy bun, wearing an oversized thrifted black band t-shirt and a silver thumb ring

scenes.narration: For two years, my acoustic guitar only ever heard my bedroom walls and my cat. Playing in front of real people felt entirely impossible.
scenes.visual: close up of scarred wooden guitar body resting on a messy bed with tangled instrument cables and loose sheet music scattered around

scenes.narration: My friends practically dragged me to the crowded neighborhood coffeehouse, pushing my name onto the open mic sign-up sheet without asking.
scenes.visual: over the shoulder shot of a clipboard sign up sheet resting on a rustic wooden counter with handwritten names and a black pen

scenes.narration: When the host called my name, my stomach dropped straight to my shoes. Walking up to that stool felt like walking the plank.
scenes.visual: POV shot walking across dim wooden floorboards toward a single illuminated wooden stool and a glowing microphone stand

scenes.narration: I sat down, wrapped my trembling fingers around the guitar neck, and looked out at a sea of strangers staring right back at me.
scenes.visual: close up of shaking hands trying to steady a wooden guitar neck against a dark background with warm string lights glowing softly

scenes.narration: My fingers completely missed the first chord change, producing a loud, ugly buzz that made me want to drop the pick and run.
scenes.visual: extreme close up of a guitar pick slipping awkwardly across metal strings capturing a blurred moment of hesitation

scenes.narration: Instead of bolting, I closed my eyes, reset my hand, and let the familiar rhythm of the second verse take over my nerves.
scenes.visual: profile view of focused face with eyes closed strumming vigorously with expressive hand movement and warm stage spotlight glow

scenes.narration: By the final chorus, the whole room was nodding along, and when I finished, the applause washed away every ounce of my fear.
scenes.visual: medium shot of smiling musician looking up from guitar toward cheering crowd with warm glowing ambient cafe lights

scenes.narration: More daily stories about facing fears and finding your voice are waiting right here, so follow along for more.
scenes.visual: direct portrait looking at camera with a confident relaxed smile holding acoustic guitar neck across shoulder
